en.description: Diagrams from text: PlantUML, Mermaid, Graphviz and more
en.notes: Send a diagram’s source to https://{host}/<type>/svg, as /plantuml/svg or /mermaid/svg, and get the picture back; editors and docs tools take https://{host} as their Kroki server. Kroki has no accounts: anyone with the address can use it. BPMN and Excalidraw are left out, to save memory.

Kroki hat keine Konten: Alle, die die Adresse haben, können es nutzen. BPMN und Excalidraw sind weggelassen, um Speicher zu sparen.
